chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris from Ali ibn Muhammad from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Muhammad ibn Abi Umair from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala' from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When Salman (may Allah be pleased with him) entered Kufa and looked at it, he mentioned the tribulations that would befall it, until he mentioned the rule of Bani Umayyah and those who came after them. Then he said: 'When that occurs, remain in the sitting areas of your houses until the Pure One, son of the Pure, the Purifier, the one with occultation, the Wandering Exile, appears.'

key_terms.الطَّاهِرُ: The Pure One, a title for the Mahdi
key_terms.الْغَيْبَة: Occultation, the period of concealment of the Imam
key_terms.الْكُوفَةَ: Kufa, a major city in Iraq
key_terms.سَلْمَانُ: Salman al-Farsi, a companion of the Prophet and Imams

ai.seo_question: What did Salman al-Farsi predict about Kufa and the appearance of the Mahdi?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights Salman al-Farsi’s prophetic foresight regarding Kufa’s future tribulations under the Umayyads, linking them to the era of the Mahdi’s occultation. The description of the Mahdi as 'al-Sharid al-Tarid' (the wandering exile) underscores the theme of hidden leadership and patience during the period of waiting, a central concept in Twelver Shia eschatology.
